def.zh-tw: 在已知事件 $A$ 發生（$P(A)>0$）的條件下，事件 $B$ 發生的機率，記作 $P(B\mid A)$，$P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$；相當於把樣本空間縮成 $A$ 再計算。
def.en: The probability that an event $B$ happens given that an event $A$ has happened ($P(A)>0$), written $P(B\mid A)$: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. It amounts to shrinking the sample space to $A$ and working inside it.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：條件機率 conditional probability

def.zh-tw: 若 $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$，就稱事件 $A$、$B$ 為獨立事件；當 $P(A)>0$ 時，這等於說 $P(B\mid A)=P(B)$，知道 $A$ 發生不改變 $B$ 的機率。
def.en: Events $A$ and $B$ are independent if $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$. When $P(A)>0$ this says $P(B\mid A)=P(B)$: knowing that $A$ happened does not change the probability of $B$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：獨立事件 independent events

def.zh-tw: 把同一群資料依兩種分類方式交叉計數所列成的表格；每一格對應兩種分類同時成立的情形，各列、各行的合計就是單一分類的個數。
def.en: A table that counts the same data under two ways of classifying it at once; each cell is one combination of the two classes, and the row and column totals count each class on its own.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：列聯表 contingency table
